title: Grounded thermal diagnosis
provenance: hand-authored for tests/demo; NOT recorded from the Anthropic API. Re-record with: python -m ai_diagnosis ... --backend anthropic --record

response.hypothesis: GPU 2 on node-03 is thermally throttling (SW_THERMAL), most likely due to degraded cooling on that GPU, since its same-node peers are much cooler.

claims.text: GPU 2 temperature rose from 57.67 C to 88.65 C within the window.
Its SM clock fell to 1762.7 MHz while same-node peers run at a median 1982.8 MHz.
The throttle-reasons bitmask is SW_THERMAL, not power capping.
Peer GPUs on node-03 sit at a median 66.71 C, so this is local to GPU 2 rather than a room/rack inlet problem.
No ECC or XID activity accompanies the throttling.

response.next_action: Check fan/airflow and heatsink seating for node-03 GPU 2 (nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,PERFORMANCE); if throttling persists, drain node-03 via the bring-up gate and re-run DCGM diag level 3.
